newsitem.title: MEXICO: Anheuser-Busch may raise stake in Modelo.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser-Busch may raise stake in Modelo.

text.p: U.S. beer giant Anheuser-Bush Co Inc may raise its stake in the lucrative Mexican beer company Grupo Modelo to 35.12 percent from the current 10 percent, a top Modelo official said.

"This means that Anhueser-Busch would continue being a minority investor. Control of the company will remain with the current controlling group," Emilio Fuyaondo, Modelo's director of investor relations, told Reuters in an interview.
Modelo is Mexico's dominant beer maker and one of the healthiest companies trading on the Mexican stock exchange. Its foreign sales are led by the popular Corona brand.
Fuyaondo said Anheuser-Busch has options to raise its stake in Modelo to 35.12 percent and to increase its share of the Modelo subsidiary Diblos to 23.5 percent.
"As to whether they have made us a formal proposal to acquire an addtional percentage, so far there hasn't been anything," he said.
Should Anhueser-Busch exercise its options, current investors in Modelo would not see a dilution of their shares because the deal would be "a direct sale of controlling shares," Fuyaondo said.
-- Maria Luisa Aguilar, Mexico City Newsroom (525) 728-9553
